label: D1 after an unrewarded trial while the policy leans a2 (earlier in the episode)
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.4% of mass; never at D2, rarely at GO). It needs the reward input to be 0 (previous trial unrewarded: 95% of mass) and the agent leaning toward a2 (policy logit a1-a2 < -1.5 at that step; the upcoming choice is a2 for 99.8% of mass, a1 almost never). It does not fire after rewarded trials or when the agent prefers a1. So the unit is asymmetric: an a2-side no-reward signal. D1 & prev_reward==0 & choice<-1.5 gives dev F1 0.68 with mass recall 0.93. Adding ep_trial<80 raises F1 to 0.76, because the rate falls steadily over the episode and is zero after trial ~85; that is a slow drift, not a task variable. Magnitude: biggest (~0.9-1.0 of max) on the first unrewarded D1 after a rewarded trial, then it decays over consecutive unrewarded trials (~0.57, then ~0.33). It fires more often after a rare transition (rate 0.097 vs 0.014 after common; 72% of mass). Weak small activations at D1 after rewarded trials make up most of the misses. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables plus the model own policy logit (no future variables).
